provenance.note: etnaviv.xml carries no per-model gating: one description covers the GC family, and what differs per model lives in the driver's feature bits, not in these bit layouts. Our target is the GC7000UL (model 0x7000, revision 0x6204, HALTI5). Instructions are a fixed 128 bits; the opcode is bits 5:0 plus bit 80.
